d: Job Purpose:This role is responsible for supporting the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of General Assembly manufacturing equipment and processes. This role contributes to process planning, quality control activities, facility readiness, and manufacturing engineering initiatives to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality production operations.
q: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or equivalent
3 years minimum in a relevant field.
r: li
Support the development and maintenance of General Assembly manufacturing processes, work standards, and process documentation.
li
Prepare and maintain PFMEAs, control plans, process flows, work instructions, and related manufacturing engineering documentation.
li
Support manufacturing process planning activities using approved engineering systems and digital manufacturing tools.
li
Participate in engineering change management activities, ensuring timely evaluation and implementation of product and process changes.
li
Support facility planning, equipment implementation, commissioning, and manufacturing readiness activities.
li
Perform process analysis and manufacturing studies to identify opportunities for quality, efficiency, safety, and productivity improvements.
li
Collaborate with Production, Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Maintenance, and other stakeholders to support operational requirements and issue resolution.
li
Assist in validating manufacturing equipment, processes, and production systems to ensure compliance with design and operational requirements.
li
Monitor manufacturing performance indicators and support corrective actions to improve process capability and operational effectiveness
li
Maintain accurate process, equipment, and manufacturing data within engineering and manufacturing systems.
